title: Commitment Size, Loan-to-Cost and Budget Reserve Limits — Construction Loans
content:
Commitment limits for Construction Loans are set per product: a smallest and a largest commitment in dollars, a ceiling as a percentage of the approved project budget, a ceiling as a percentage of the as-completed appraised value, a required contingency line in the budget, and a tolerance for cumulative change orders.

## Underwriting limits schedule

| Product | Smallest commitment | Largest commitment | Largest commitment as % of approved project budget (loan-to-cost) | Largest commitment as % of as-completed appraised value | Contingency line, % of hard costs | Cumulative change orders without re-underwriting, % of budget | Cost overrun paid from member's own funds before further draws |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | USD 75000 | USD 400000 | 80 | 75 | 10 | 5 | Yes |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | USD 100000 | USD 832750 | 90 | 90 | 5 | 10 | Yes |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | USD 100000 | USD 1500000 | 85 | 85 | 5 | 10 | Yes |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | USD 100000 | USD 750000 | 85 | 80 | 7.5 | 10 | Yes |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | USD 100000 | USD 2000000 | 80 | 75 | 7.5 | 10 | Yes |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | USD 500000 | USD 6000000 | 75 | 65 | 7.5 | 7.5 | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Smallest commitment** — Smallest commitment, USD.
- **Largest commitment** — Largest commitment, USD.
- **Loan-to-cost limit** — Largest commitment as % of the approved project budget.
- **Loan-to-completed-value limit** — Largest commitment as % of the as-completed appraised value.
- **Contingency reserve** — Contingency line required in the budget, % of hard costs.
- **Change order tolerance** — Cumulative change orders allowed without re-underwriting, % of the budget.
- **Overrun equity first** — Boolean; whether a cost overrun must be paid from the member's own funds before further draws.

## Notes to the schedule

1. The two percentage ceilings are separate figures for each product: on the Single-Close and Two-Close Home Construction Loans they are equal (90 and 90, 85 and 85), while on the Owner-Builder, Post-Frame, Farm Building and Livestock Facility products the as-completed value ceiling is the lower figure.
2. The Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan carries the smallest minimum, USD 75000, and the Livestock Facility Construction Loan the largest, USD 500000; the other four products start at USD 100000.
3. A cost overrun is to be met from the member's own funds before further draws on every Construction Loans product listed.
